race.comment: The lightly raced MELEK (7) is clearly on top. He's been solid in three runs this time in without winning, missing a nose two back at Ballarat then grinding home as favourite at Seymour when staying at 2000m. The rise in trip now looks perfect and he can atone from a soft gate. YAHOO BAR (1) has been solid in two runs back, beaten narrowly by SALSITA (3) last start at Seymour. Little between that pair there but fancy YAHOO BAR can turn the tables with added fitness. ONLY OPERA (15) was behind that pair at Seymour but was hard in the market and won well prior. She can improve up in trip. AMAWASHA (11) is racing consistently and looks a solid each way chance.
